control "submission_worker_no_logpush" {
  title       = "Submission Worker scripts must have Logpush disabled"
  description = "SPEC §5.3 / §7 and GDPR Art. 25 require SurveyBeat's Submission Worker to keep Logpush off so submission requests are never exported to log pipelines."
  severity    = "critical"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with submission_workers as (
      select
        id,
        account_id,
        logpush
      from
        cloudflare_worker_script
      where
        id ilike $1 || '%'
        and id ilike '%submission%'
    )
    select
      w.id as resource,
      case
        when w.logpush is true then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when w.logpush is true then 'Submission Worker ' || w.id || ' has logpush enabled.'
        else 'Submission Worker ' || w.id || ' has logpush disabled.'
      end as reason
    from
      submission_workers as w
    union all
    select
      a.id as resource,
      'info' as status,
      'No Submission Worker scripts (*submission*) found in account ' || a.name || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_account as a
    where
      not exists (select 1 from submission_workers);
  EOQ

  param "worker_prefix" {
    default = var.worker_prefix
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "WorkerPrivacy"
  })
}

control "submission_worker_no_tail_consumers" {
  title       = "Submission Worker scripts must have no tail consumers attached"
  description = "SPEC §5.3 / §7 and GDPR Art. 25 require SurveyBeat's Submission Worker to attach zero tail consumers, as tail events carry unredacted client IP headers and request metadata."
  severity    = "critical"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with submission_workers as (
      select
        id,
        account_id,
        tail_consumers
      from
        cloudflare_worker_script
      where
        id ilike $1 || '%'
        and id ilike '%submission%'
    )
    select
      w.id as resource,
      case
        when jsonb_array_length(coalesce(w.tail_consumers, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0 then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when jsonb_array_length(coalesce(w.tail_consumers, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0
          then 'Submission Worker ' || w.id || ' has ' || jsonb_array_length(w.tail_consumers) || ' tail consumer(s) attached.'
        else 'Submission Worker ' || w.id || ' has no tail consumers attached.'
      end as reason
    from
      submission_workers as w
    union all
    select
      a.id as resource,
      'info' as status,
      'No Submission Worker scripts (*submission*) found in account ' || a.name || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_account as a
    where
      not exists (select 1 from submission_workers);
  EOQ

  param "worker_prefix" {
    default = var.worker_prefix
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "WorkerPrivacy"
  })
}

control "logpush_no_unfiltered_submission_pii" {
  title       = "Logpush jobs must not export ClientIP/ClientRequestURI for Submission hosts or workers_trace_events"
  description = "Per docs/research/workers-logging-privacy.md §5 and GDPR Art. 25, enabled HTTP request Logpush jobs must filter out submit.* hosts or omit ClientIP/ClientRequestURI, and workers_trace_events should not capture Submission requests."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with account_jobs as (
      select
        a.id as scope_id,
        a.name as scope_name,
        j.id as job_id,
        coalesce(j.name, j.id::text) as job_name,
        j.dataset,
        j.enabled,
        coalesce(j.logpull_options, '') as logpull_options,
        coalesce(j.output_options::text, '') as output_options_text
      from
        cloudflare_account as a
        left join lateral (
          select id, name, dataset, enabled, logpull_options, output_options
          from cloudflare_logpush_job
          where account_id = a.id
        ) as j on true
    ),
    zone_jobs as (
      select
        z.id as scope_id,
        z.name as scope_name,
        j.id as job_id,
        coalesce(j.name, j.id::text) as job_name,
        j.dataset,
        j.enabled,
        coalesce(j.logpull_options, '') as logpull_options,
        coalesce(j.output_options::text, '') as output_options_text
      from
        cloudflare_zone as z
        left join lateral (
          select id, name, dataset, enabled, logpull_options, output_options
          from cloudflare_logpush_job
          where zone_id = z.id
        ) as j on true
      where
        '*' = any($1::text[]) or z.name = any($1::text[])
    ),
    all_scopes as (
      select * from account_jobs
      union all
      select * from zone_jobs
    )
    select
      coalesce(job_id::text, scope_id) as resource,
      case
        when job_id is null then 'ok'
        when not enabled then 'ok'
        when dataset = 'workers_trace_events' then 'alarm'
        when dataset = 'http_requests'
          and (logpull_options ilike '%ClientIP%' or logpull_options ilike '%ClientRequestURI%' or output_options_text ilike '%ClientIP%' or output_options_text ilike '%ClientRequestURI%')
          then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when job_id is null then 'No Logpush jobs configured for ' || scope_name || '.'
        when not enabled then 'Logpush job ' || job_name || ' (' || dataset || ') on ' || scope_name || ' is disabled.'
        when dataset = 'workers_trace_events'
          then 'Enabled Logpush job ' || job_name || ' exports workers_trace_events; verify Submission Workers have logpush=false.'
        when dataset = 'http_requests'
          and (logpull_options ilike '%ClientIP%' or logpull_options ilike '%ClientRequestURI%' or output_options_text ilike '%ClientIP%' or output_options_text ilike '%ClientRequestURI%')
          then 'Enabled http_requests Logpush job ' || job_name || ' on ' || scope_name || ' includes ClientIP or ClientRequestURI.'
        else 'Enabled Logpush job ' || job_name || ' (' || dataset || ') on ' || scope_name || ' does not export ClientIP/ClientRequestURI.'
      end as reason
    from
      all_scopes;
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "LogPrivacy"
  })
}

control "zone_ssl_strict" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should enforce Full (strict) SSL/TLS mode"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.7 require end-to-end encrypted transport with origin certificate validation (ssl = 'strict')."
  severity    = "critical"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      z.id as resource,
      case
        when s.value = 'strict' then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      z.name || ' SSL/TLS mode is ' || coalesce(s.value, 'not set') || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_zone as z
      left join cloudflare_zone_setting as s
        on s.zone_id = z.id and s.id = 'ssl'
    where
      '*' = any($1::text[]) or z.name = any($1::text[]);
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "EncryptionInTransit"
  })
}

control "zone_min_tls_version" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should enforce minimum TLS version 1.2 or 1.3"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.7 disallow deprecated TLS 1.0 and 1.1 protocols."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      z.id as resource,
      case
        when s.value in ('1.2', '1.3') then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      z.name || ' minimum TLS version is ' || coalesce(s.value, 'not set') || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_zone as z
      left join cloudflare_zone_setting as s
        on s.zone_id = z.id and s.id = 'min_tls_version'

  param "target_zones" {

  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {

    category = "EncryptionInTransit"
  })
}

control "zone_tls_1_3_enabled" {

  })

control "zone_always_use_https" {

control "zone_automatic_https_rewrites" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should enable Automatic HTTPS Rewrites"
  description = "Prevents mixed-content leaks by rewriting insecure HTTP links to HTTPS (GDPR Art. 32, SOC 2 CC6.7)."
  severity    = "low"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      z.id as resource,
      case
        when s.value = 'on' then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      z.name || ' Automatic HTTPS Rewrites is ' || coalesce(s.value, 'not set') || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_zone as z
      left join cloudflare_zone_setting as s
        on s.zone_id = z.id and s.id = 'automatic_https_rewrites'
    where

control "zone_hsts_enabled" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should enable HSTS with max-age >= 6 months and nosniff"
  description = "Enforces HTTP Strict Transport Security so browsers refuse downgrade attacks on surveybeat.app (GDPR Art. 32, SOC 2 CC6.7)."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with parsed as (
      select
        z.id,
        z.name,
        case
          when s.value is not null and s.value ~ '^\\s*\\{' then s.value::jsonb -> 'strict_transport_security'
          else null
        end as hsts
      from
        cloudflare_zone as z
        left join cloudflare_zone_setting as s
          on s.zone_id = z.id and s.id = 'security_header'
      where
        '*' = any($1::text[]) or z.name = any($1::text[])
    )
    select
      id as resource,
      case
        when hsts is null then 'alarm'
        when coalesce((hsts ->> 'enabled')::boolean, false) is false then 'alarm'
        when coalesce((hsts ->> 'max_age')::bigint, 0) < 15552000 then 'alarm'
        when coalesce((hsts ->> 'nosniff')::boolean, false) is false then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when hsts is null then name || ' has no security_header HSTS configuration.'
        when coalesce((hsts ->> 'enabled')::boolean, false) is false then name || ' has HSTS disabled.'
        when coalesce((hsts ->> 'max_age')::bigint, 0) < 15552000
          then name || ' HSTS max_age is ' || coalesce(hsts ->> 'max_age', '0') || 's (expected >= 15552000s).'
        when coalesce((hsts ->> 'nosniff')::boolean, false) is false
          then name || ' HSTS has X-Content-Type-Options nosniff disabled.'
        else name || ' has HSTS enabled (max_age=' || (hsts ->> 'max_age') || 's, include_subdomains=' || coalesce(hsts ->> 'include_subdomains', 'false') || ', nosniff=true).'
      end as reason
    from
      parsed;
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "EncryptionInTransit"
  })
}

control "zone_waf_enabled" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should have WAF rulesets or WAF protection enabled"
  description = "SOC 2 CC6.6 and GDPR Art. 32 require Web Application Firewall filtering to block common edge exploits."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      z.id as resource,
      case
        when s.value = 'on' or coalesce(r.ruleset_count, 0) > 0 then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when coalesce(r.ruleset_count, 0) > 0
          then z.name || ' has ' || r.ruleset_count || ' active WAF/rate-limit ruleset(s) (legacy waf=' || coalesce(s.value, 'unset') || ').'
        when s.value = 'on'
          then z.name || ' has legacy WAF setting enabled.'
        else z.name || ' has no WAF rulesets and WAF setting is ' || coalesce(s.value, 'not set') || '.'
      end as reason
    from
      cloudflare_zone as z
      left join cloudflare_zone_setting as s
        on s.zone_id = z.id and s.id = 'waf'
      left join lateral (
        select
          count(*) as ruleset_count
        from
          cloudflare_ruleset
        where
          zone_id = z.id
          and phase in (
            'http_request_firewall_managed',
            'http_request_firewall_custom',
            'http_ratelimit'
          )
      ) as r on true
    where
      '*' = any($1::text[]) or z.name = any($1::text[]);
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "BoundaryProtection"
  })
}

  param "target_zones" {

  }

    category = "BoundaryProtection"
  })
}

control "zone_security_level_appropriate" {

control "zone_leaked_credential_check" {

  description = "Detects compromised credentials at the edge (SOC 2 CC6.6)."

control "zone_security_txt_configured" {

  })
}

control "zone_active_not_paused" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones must be active and not paused"
  description = "SOC 2 A1.2 / CC6.6: pausing a zone bypasses Cloudflare proxy, WAF, and TLS protections."
  severity    = "critical"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      id as resource,
      case
        when status = 'active' and coalesce(paused, false) is false then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      name || ' status is ' || coalesce(status, 'unknown') || ', paused=' || coalesce(paused::text, 'false') || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_zone
    where
      '*' = any($1::text[]) or name = any($1::text[]);

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "Availability"
  })
}

control "zone_dnssec_enabled" {

control "dns_caa_record_configured" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should define CAA DNS records"
  description = "SOC 2 CC6.6: Certification Authority Authorization (CAA) records restrict which CAs may issue TLS certificates for surveybeat.app."
  severity    = "medium"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      z.id as resource,
      case
        when coalesce(c.caa_count, 0) > 0 then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when coalesce(c.caa_count, 0) > 0 then z.name || ' has ' || c.caa_count || ' CAA record(s).'

  })
}

control "dns_email_auth_records" {
  title       = "Cloudflare zones should publish unique SPF and DMARC DNS records"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.6: protects SurveyBeat invitation and email-code sign-in flows from domain spoofing and detects duplicate DMARC records."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      z.id as resource,
      case
        when coalesce(t.has_root_spf, false)
          and t.root_dmarc_count = 1
          and coalesce(t.has_notify_spf, false)
          and t.notify_dmarc_count = 1 then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      z.name
        || ' root SPF=' || coalesce(t.has_root_spf::text, 'false')
        || ', root DMARC records=' || coalesce(t.root_dmarc_count, 0)
        || ', notify SPF=' || coalesce(t.has_notify_spf::text, 'false')
        || ', notify DMARC records=' || coalesce(t.notify_dmarc_count, 0)
        || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_zone as z
      left join lateral (
        select
          bool_or(r.name = z.name and replace(r.content, '"', '') ilike 'v=spf1%') as has_root_spf,
          count(*) filter (where r.name = '_dmarc.' || z.name and replace(r.content, '"', '') ilike 'v=DMARC1%') as root_dmarc_count,
          bool_or((r.name = 'notify.' || z.name or r.name = 'cf-bounce.notify.' || z.name) and replace(r.content, '"', '') ilike 'v=spf1%') as has_notify_spf,
          count(*) filter (where r.name = '_dmarc.notify.' || z.name and replace(r.content, '"', '') ilike 'v=DMARC1%') as notify_dmarc_count
        from cloudflare_dns_record as r
        where r.zone_id = z.id and r.type = 'TXT'
      ) as t on true
    where
      '*' = any($1::text[]) or z.name = any($1::text[]);
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "EmailSecurity"
  })
}

control "dns_sensitive_records_proxied" {
  title       = "SurveyBeat web and submission DNS records must be proxied through Cloudflare"
  description = "Ensures A/AAAA/CNAME records for surveybeat.app, dashboard, and submit hosts route through Cloudflare WAF and TLS termination (GDPR Art. 32, SOC 2 CC6.6)."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with target_zones as (
      select id, name
      from cloudflare_zone
      where '*' = any($1::text[]) or name = any($1::text[])
    ),
    app_records as (
      select
        r.id,
        z.name as zone_name,
        r.name,
        r.type,
        r.proxied
      from
        target_zones as z
        join cloudflare_dns_record as r on r.zone_id = z.id
      where
        r.type in ('A', 'AAAA', 'CNAME')
        and r.proxiable is true
        and (
          r.name = z.name
          or r.name like 'www.%'
          or r.name like 'app.%'
          or r.name like 'dashboard.%'
          or r.name like 'submit.%'
          or r.name like 'staging.%'
        )
    )
    select
      r.id as resource,
      case
        when r.proxied is true then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      r.type || ' record ' || r.name || ' is ' || case when r.proxied is true then 'proxied.' else 'DNS-only (unproxied).' end as reason
    from
      app_records as r
    union all
    select
      z.id as resource,
      'info' as status,
      'No proxiable app/submit A, AAAA, or CNAME DNS records found in zone ' || z.name || '.' as reason
    from
      target_zones as z
    where
      not exists (select 1 from app_records as ar where ar.zone_name = z.name);
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "BoundaryProtection"
  })
}

control "account_enforce_twofactor" {
  title       = "Cloudflare accounts must enforce two-factor authentication for all members"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.1 require multi-factor authentication on administrative control-plane access."
  severity    = "critical"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      id as resource,
      case
        when coalesce((settings ->> 'enforce_twofactor')::boolean, false) is true then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when coalesce((settings ->> 'enforce_twofactor')::boolean, false) is true
          then 'Account ' || name || ' enforces two-factor authentication.'
        else 'Account ' || name || ' does not enforce two-factor authentication (settings.enforce_twofactor=' || coalesce(settings ->> 'enforce_twofactor', 'unset') || ').'
      end as reason
    from
      cloudflare_account;
  EOQ

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "AccessControl"
  })
}

control "user_mfa_enabled" {
  title       = "Authenticated Cloudflare user must have two-factor authentication enabled"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.1 require MFA on the Cloudflare user context."
  severity    = "critical"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      id as resource,
      case
        when two_factor_authentication_enabled is true then 'ok'
        when two_factor_authentication_enabled is null then 'info'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when two_factor_authentication_enabled is true
          then 'User ' || coalesce(email, id) || ' has 2FA enabled.'
        when two_factor_authentication_enabled is null
          then 'User ' || coalesce(email, id) || ' 2FA field omitted by current credential; check account member 2FA control.'
        else 'User ' || coalesce(email, id) || ' does not have 2FA enabled.'
      end as reason
    from
      cloudflare_user;
  EOQ

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "AccessControl"
  })
}

control "account_member_accepted_and_mfa" {
  title       = "Cloudflare account members should be accepted and have 2FA enabled"
  description = "SOC 2 CC6.1 / CC6.2: identifies stale pending invitations and account members lacking 2FA."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    select
      m.id as resource,
      case
        when m.status <> 'accepted' then 'alarm'
        when coalesce((m.user ->> 'two_factor_authentication_enabled')::boolean, false) is false then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      coalesce(m.user_email, m.id)
        || ' membership status=' || coalesce(m.status, 'unknown')
        || ', 2FA=' || coalesce(m.user ->> 'two_factor_authentication_enabled', 'unknown')
        || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_account_member as m;
  EOQ

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "AccessControl"
  })
}

control "api_token_expiration_set" {
  title       = "Active Cloudflare API tokens should have an expiration date"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.1 / CC6.2: non-expiring API tokens increase blast radius of credential exposure."
  severity    = "medium"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with tokens as (
      select
        id,
        name,
        status,
        case
          when expires_on is null or expires_on < '1970-01-01'::timestamptz then null
          else expires_on
        end as real_expires_on
      from
        cloudflare_api_token
    )
    select
      t.id as resource,
      case
        when t.status <> 'active' then 'skip'
        when t.real_expires_on is null then 'alarm'
        when t.real_expires_on <= now() then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when t.status <> 'active' then 'API token ' || t.name || ' is ' || t.status || '.'
        when t.real_expires_on is null then 'Active API token ' || t.name || ' has no expiration date.'
        when t.real_expires_on <= now() then 'API token ' || t.name || ' expired at ' || t.real_expires_on::text || '.'
        else 'Active API token ' || t.name || ' expires on ' || t.real_expires_on::text || '.'
      end as reason
    from
      tokens as t
    union all
    select
      u.id as resource,
      'info' as status,
      'No user-scoped API tokens visible to current credential.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_user as u
    where
      not exists (select 1 from tokens);
  EOQ

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "CredentialHygiene"
  })
}

control "api_token_ip_condition" {
  title       = "Active Cloudflare API tokens should document IP allowlist conditions where feasible"
  description = "SOC 2 CC6.1 defense-in-depth: checks whether active API tokens restrict client IP ranges (informational when used by dynamic GitHub-hosted runners)."
  severity    = "low"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with tokens as (
      select
        id,
        name,
        status,
        condition -> 'request_ip' -> 'in' as ip_in
      from
        cloudflare_api_token
    )
    select
      t.id as resource,
      case
        when t.status <> 'active' then 'skip'
        when t.ip_in is not null and jsonb_array_length(t.ip_in) > 0 then 'ok'
        else 'info'
      end as status,
      case
        when t.status <> 'active' then 'API token ' || t.name || ' is ' || t.status || '.'
        when t.ip_in is not null and jsonb_array_length(t.ip_in) > 0 then 'API token ' || t.name || ' restricts client IPs.'
        else 'API token ' || t.name || ' has no IP allowlist condition (expected for GitHub-hosted runners; restrict if static).'
      end as reason
    from
      tokens as t
    union all
    select
      u.id as resource,
      'info' as status,
      'No user-scoped API tokens visible to current credential.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_user as u
    where
      not exists (select 1 from tokens);
  EOQ

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "CredentialHygiene"
  })
}

control "access_policy_no_unrestricted_bypass" {
  title       = "Cloudflare Access policies must not grant unrestricted everyone bypass/allow"
  description = "GDPR Art. 32 and SOC 2 CC6.1: flags Access policies on target zones that bypass authentication or allow everyone with no require rules."
  severity    = "high"

  sql = <<-EOQ
    with scoped_policies as (
      select
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.application_name,
        a.domain as application_domain,
        p.decision,
        p.include,
        coalesce(p.require, '[]'::jsonb) as require_rules
      from
        cloudflare_access_policy as p
        join cloudflare_access_application as a on a.id = p.application_id
      where
        '*' = any($1::text[])
        or exists (
          select 1
          from unnest($1::text[]) as tz
          where a.domain ilike '%' || tz || '%'
        )
    )
    select
      p.id as resource,
      case
        when p.decision = 'bypass' and p.include::text ilike '%"everyone"%' then 'alarm'
        when p.decision = 'allow'
          and p.include::text ilike '%"everyone"%'
          and jsonb_array_length(p.require_rules) = 0 then 'alarm'
        else 'ok'
      end as status,
      case
        when p.decision = 'bypass' and p.include::text ilike '%"everyone"%'
          then 'Access policy ' || p.name || ' on ' || coalesce(p.application_name, p.application_domain) || ' bypasses authentication for everyone.'
        when p.decision = 'allow'
          and p.include::text ilike '%"everyone"%'
          and jsonb_array_length(p.require_rules) = 0
          then 'Access policy ' || p.name || ' on ' || coalesce(p.application_name, p.application_domain) || ' allows everyone with zero require rules.'
        else 'Access policy ' || p.name || ' (' || p.decision || ') enforces authentication requirements.'
      end as reason
    from
      scoped_policies as p
    union all
    select
      acc.id as resource,
      'ok' as status,
      'No Cloudflare Access policies scoped to target zones in account ' || acc.name || '.' as reason
    from
      cloudflare_account as acc
    where
      not exists (select 1 from scoped_policies);
  EOQ

  param "target_zones" {
    default = var.target_zones
  }

  tags = merge(local.common_tags, {
    gdpr     = "true"
    soc2     = "true"
    category = "AccessControl"
  })
}

All hostnames on `surveybeat.app` resolve to Cloudflare Workers, indicating a serverless architecture. Examining the DNS records, there is a clear pattern of proxied records pointing to IPv6 addresses. This confirms the primary service delivery method is through Cloudflare's platform.


`app.surveybeat.app`, `dashboard.surveybeat.app`, `submit.surveybeat.app`, and staging/PR subdomains are also served directly via Cloudflare Workers, confirming the serverless setup across the core application. Non-proxied hostnames (`accounts`, `clerk`, `dev`, `mail`) point to external services or specific IPs, bypassing Cloudflare's proxy. Cloudflare security settings like SSL enforcement, TLS version, and HSTS only apply to the proxied traffic handled by Workers, representing the primary application layer.


Initial assessment: focusing on the `include_subdomains` flag for HSTS settings, considering potential HTTP-only endpoints on unproxied subdomains. The goal is to ensure HSTS configuration doesn't inadvertently break services like `dev.surveybeat.app` or `mail.surveybeat.app`. The `zone_hsts_enabled` setting offers a safer approach, and its settings will be investigated.

Further investigation of the Cloudflare infrastructure will be done via `AGENTS.md` and `@alchemy.run/cloudflare` for declared resources and settings. Examining `cf` CLI commands will help determine DNSSEC status and registrar information for proper setup, especially the DS records required for DNSSEC.

The search for "Cloudflare Registrar DNSSEC pending status automatic DS record .app domain" returned the following summary:
When you manage a domain using **Cloudflare Registrar** (including TLDs like `.app`), enabling DNSSEC is meant to be fully automated[1]. 

### How it is *supposed* to work
1. When you toggle DNSSEC on in your Cloudflare dashboard, Cloudflare generates the cryptographic keys and creates the DS (Delegation Signer) record details[1].
2. Because Cloudflare is your registrar, they automatically submit/publish the DS record to the parent registry (e.g., the `.app` registry operated by Google Registry) using automated scanning (CDS/CDNSKEY records)[1].
3. Official documentation states that this automated process typically takes **1 to 2 days** to clear and switch from **Pending** to **Active**[1].

---

### Why it gets stuck on "Pending"
If your `.app` domain has been stuck on a **Pending** status for several days, it is a known issue frequently experienced by Cloudflare Registrar users across various TLDs (`.com`, `.net`, `.app`, `.cloud`, etc.)[1][2][3]. 

Common causes include:
* **The Automated Pipeline Stalled:** Cloudflare's backend automated CDS/CDNSKEY polling mechanism occasionally fails to pick up or push the records to the registry API within the expected window[1].
* **Registry Propagation Delays / Sync Lags:** Communication delays between Cloudflare Registrar's backend and the specific TLD registry operator.

---

### What you can do to fix or troubleshoot it

1. **Verify your zone is publishing the right signals:**
   You can check if your domain is properly broadcasting its intent via terminal/command line using `dig`:
   ```bash
   dig CDS yourdomain.app
   dig CDNSKEY yourdomain.app
   ```
   If these return valid records matching the parameters shown in your Cloudflare dashboard, your side of the configuration is correct, and the bottleneck is strictly on Cloudflare's automated registrar backend[1].

2. **Disable and Re-enable DNSSEC (Sometimes helps reset the hook):**
   * Go to your Cloudflare Dashboard -> **DNS** -> **Settings**.
   * Turn **DNSSEC** off.
   * Wait roughly 10–15 minutes, then turn **DNSSEC** back on. 
   * *Note:* While this sometimes forces a re-initiation of the script, many users note that it can also remain stuck if the backend automation queue itself is stalled[2].

3. **Check if manual override is possible:**
   For domains *not* on Cloudflare Registrar, Cloudflare provides manual DS record strings for you to paste into your registrar's panel[4]. However, because Cloudflare *is* the registrar for a `.app` domain, they usually abstract away and lock the manual registrar management fields, leaving you dependent on their automation. 

4. **Contact Cloudflare Support:**
   Because this involves **Cloudflare Registrar services**, account-specific backend intervention is often required[3]. 
   * Navigate to the Cloudflare Support Portal and open a **Registrar** ticket[5]. 
   * *If you are on a Free plan* where direct ticket creation for DNS/Registrar seems restricted, look for options related to domain transfer or registrar billing/support, as registrar-specific bugs usually bypass general support limitations. Provide them with your domain name and state that the automated CDS/CDNSKEY ingestion script has stalled on the registrar side[1].
